items.title: How does Meta solve Muse's monetization problem?

items.title: How Investors May Respond To Shopify (SHOP) Mixed Earnings And AI Push
items.summary: Shopify reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$3.74b and net income of US$462m, issued guidance for low 30% revenue growth in the fourth quarter, and filed an omnibus shelf registration covering equity, debt, warrants and units. items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Braces For EU Rules With 6% Revenue Penalty Risk
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) faces new EU rules that target addictive social media features and simulated AI relationships, with potential fines of up to 6% of global revenue for violations. Draft EU regulation would require Meta products to offer users clear options to disable engagement tools that keep them scrolling for longer. The same EU package aims to limit AI systems that mimic personal intimacy, which could affect how Meta deploys conversational agents across its apps. The EU...

items.title: Meta Stock Slips After United Airlines Announces AI-Bot Ban
items.summary: Meta Platforms stock edged 2% lower after The Wall Street Journal reported that United Airlines plans to prevent personal artificial-intelligence assistants from accessing its systems to book tickets.
